name: Hazuki Kurumi
source:
She is an 11-year-old prodigy who skipped grades to transfer from St. Bernardi Academy's primary school. She can be a bit cheeky and foul-mouthed, but she also has a kind side. She transforms into White Angel and supports Haruka and Aoi with the mechanical weapons she developed.

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character3.html]official site[/url]]
